findings.label: forbidOnly gated on CI
findings.detail: forbidOnly: !!process.env.CI instead of the planned forbidOnly: true. A committed test.only would silently reduce the suite to one test and still exit 0. Set it unconditionally.

findings.label: Overflow assertions match a message string
findings.detail: These assert describeOverflow(...) does not match /overflows by/, so rewording that formatter in tests/helpers/overflow.js would make them permanently green. Assert report.offenders / report.scrollers directly, as no-horizontal-overflow.spec.js does.

findings.label: Shared demo state restored inline
findings.detail: Specs mutate seeded reactions and undo them at the end of the test body. A mid-test failure skips the undo, so one real failure can cascade into later specs and obscure the original cause. Move the restore into afterEach or re-seed per test.

findings.label: Tautological assertion
findings.detail: expect(threadResponse === null || threadResponse.ok()).toBeTruthy() cannot fail. Drop it or assert the response was actually observed.

findings.label: First run needs network
findings.detail: The CDN cache under tests/.cache/cdn/ is gitignored, so a fresh CI checkout's first run must reach cdn.jsdelivr.net and cdnjs.cloudflare.com. Documented in tests/README.md; worth a CI note.
